headline: Elected Gerry Schaffert as secretary, replacing Andrew Holt, and approved two sets of draft minutes.
summary: Members discussed a Sept. 16 visit to the Westerly Education Center and a 9/14/2026 Town Council hearing on Old Tower Hill Road zoning changes. They also talked about recruiting someone for the empty seat and about URI's delayed survey.
decisions: Approved Gerry Schaffert as secretary to replace Andrew Holt, 8-0-1.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion to approve the minutes of 7/1/2026 and 8/17/2026 was made by Tom Routliffe. The motion was seconded by Kirk Brown. Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved 8-0-1.

A motion to nominate Gerry Schaffert to replace Andrew Holt as EDC Secretary was made by Jack Cadman. The motion was seconded by Tom Routliffe. Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved 8-0-1.

plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown   
Economic Development Commission   
Meeting Minutes 
Wednesday, September 2, 2026 at 6:00 PM   
Town Hall Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Michael Gagas, Chair 
Randy Apuzzo, Vice Chair 
Thomas Routliffe 
Ken Tetzner 
Susan Marcus 
Ian Clark 
Jack Cadman 
Kirk Brown 
Gerry Schaffert 
Ibrahim Fofanah 
-- vacancy --  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
The meeting was called to order at: 6:05 PM. 
Members Present:  Michael Gagas, Randy Apuzzo,1 Kirk Brown, Jack Cadman, Ian Clark, Susan Marcus,2 Tom 
Routliffe, Gerry Schaffert, Ibrahim Fofanah 
1.  Mr. Apuzzo arrived late at 6:10 following Roll Call and Approval of Minutes.  
2.  Ms. Marcus left early at 6:25 prior to agenda item D - Old Business. 
Members Absent:  Andrew Holt, Ken Tetzner 
Staff:  Tracey Owens  
B. Approval of Minutes: 
A motion to approve the minutes of 7/1/2026 and 8/17/2026 was made by Tom Routliffe. The motion was seconded by 
Kirk Brown. Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved 8-0-1. 
(Mr. Apuzzo is counted as abstaining because he arrived at the meeting following the vote.) 
 1. 7/1/2026 Draft Minutes 
 2. 8/17/2026 Draft Minutes 
C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
 1. Survey Correspondence 
Mr. Gagas reported that he needs to follow-up on the correspondence. 
 2. 7/29/2026 email re: Council Dissolution of SMART Committee 
Ms. Marcus commented that it is important for the EDC to undertake the functions of the former SMART committee. 
 3. Old Tower Hill Road Invitations 
The EDC was informed of the letters that were sent to: GrowSmart; Wakefield Village Assoc., R.I. League of Cities & 
Towns, R.I. Business Coalition, and R.I. Commerce.  
The EDC was also provided with reply letters from GrowSmart and the R.I. League. 
D. Old Business: 
 1. Tour of Westerly State Training Facility 
Michael Gagas noted that the Westerly Education Center visit is scheduled for September 16 at 2pm at 23 Friendship 
Street, Westerly.  He will send an email invitation to EDC members and Town Staff. A discussion followed about whom 
else to invite: council, town (or planning) manager and deputy, Wakefield Village Association and the Southern R.I. 
Chamber of Commerce.
2. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan - Discussion and possible action regarding 9/14/2026 Town Council 
hearing on zoning amendments. 
Michael Gagas stated that he plans on presenting at the 9/14/2026 Town Council meeting and speaking on "The five big 
ideas," from the OTHR Plan. 
E. New Business: 
 1. Elections: Nomination & election of a new secretary to replace Andrew Holt. 
The board began with a discussion about recruiting new members to the empty seat on the EDC. Mr. Gagas spoke about 
trying to recruit another woman to serve. Mr. Apuzzo mentioned Jamie Sharp who had provided some designs for 
renovating Wakefield Elementary School. 
A motion to nominate Gerry Schaffert to replace Andrew Holt as EDC Secretary was made by Jack Cadman. The motion 
was seconded by Tom Routliffe. Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved 8-0-1. (Ms. Marcus is 
counted as abstaining as she left the meeting before the vote.) 
F. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
None. 
G. Recurring Discussion Topics: 
 1. EDC Surveys - Discussion regarding survey data collection, results & next steps 
Mr. Gagas noted that URI was procrastinating on the survey even though they committed to doing the survey. 
Discussion followed about URI's need for staff/faculty housing and integrating URI into the community better. 
 2. South Kingstown Garden Show - Continued conceptual discussion of potential event. 
H. New Discussion Issues & Future Agenda Items: 
Members mentioned the following topics for discussion on future agendas: 
1. SMART Committee/Project Management 
2. URI Medical School Relationship: Better working relationship with URI 
3. EDC Members attending or reviewing other board and commission meetings or reviewing minutes 
I. Adjournment: 
A motion was made to adjourn the meeting by Jack Cadman. The motion was seconded by Tom Routliffe and the 
meeting adjourned by unanimous consent at 6:58 PM.
